title: pittosporum lancifolium
intro: Pittosporum lancifolium, commonly known as Japanese cheesewood, is a plant species native to East Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe coughs and relieve congestion. The bioactive constituents of Pittosporum lancifolium include alkaloids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
